thread:
maria: noticing a reconcile loop from flux in eu-west-1 targeting GPU HelmRelease(s). logs show secret annotation churn.
alex: can you paste the relevant flux/helm logs? :eyes:
maria: sure, here's the tail:
```
ts=2026-02-18T08:34:10Z caller=release.go:123 component=helmrelease msg="reconcile failed" helmrelease=ml/gpu-pool error="rendered manifests contain resources that changed: secret/ml-gpu-certs annotations changed"
```
jonathan: hmm that's the cert-manager annotation being updated every 30s by the external-syncer. we've seen drift before.
maria: right — cert-syncer writes `managed-by: external-cert-sync` plus a timestamp annotation.
priya: that timestamp churn causes flux to detect diffs and reapply helmrelease, which then triggers a rollout in ml namespace and blocks the autoscaler for the GPU pool.
alex: autoscaler blocked how? any kube events?
maria: kube events show repeated HelmRelease reconcile -> job create -> job deleted -> rollout restarts. GPU-node-pool autoscalerctl waits on nodeSelector label `pool/size` which gets removed by the helm chart during these re-applies.
deploy-bot: deploy 1902345600 started by @maria
sre-bot: alert: flux.reconcile.spike on cluster eu-west-1 (5x baseline) — linked to helmrelease/ml/gpu-pool
jonathan: short term: can we exclude the cert secret from flux using kustomize/ignore or set annotation to immutable? longer term: make cert-syncer write stable annotation.
alex: quick mitigation: add `fluxcd.io/ignore: "true"` to the specific secret via a patch in the repo, or update the HelmRelease to adopt existing secret instead of templating it.
priya: I can open a branch with a `kustomize` patch to set `fluxcd.io/ignore: "true"` on that secret, then we can promote.
maria: please do. also let's add a reconciliation webhook throttling rule on the HelmRelease so it doesn't spin up jobs every diff.
jonathan: created PR #207 with the patch and a note about cert-syncer. cc @alex
alex: merged PR, applying via flux now.
sre-bot: info: apply started for git commit abc123 -> flux triggering reconcile
maria: after merge reconciles dropped back to normal and GPU pool stopped flapping. confirming autoscaler back to normal.
alex: follow-up: schedule a ticket to change cert-syncer to write stable checksum only on real changes.
priya: opened INF-892 to track cert-syncer fix and add e2e to prevent annotation churn.
maria: thanks everyone. closing on our side, will monitor for 1hr.
